name: Saming Jao Tha
original_name: สมิงจ้าวท่า
overview: A powerful businessman uses a ship to deliver drugs. A young officer and a female spy have to work undercover in order to find evidence and arrest the businessman. They dislike each other at first but their relationship changes while they're working on the mission.
